claims: The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal was launched on March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal was launched as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal features 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal features Ramyeon McShaker Fries.
Ramyeon McShaker Fries are fries with a special seasoning mix of soy, garlic, sesame, and spice.
Ramyeon McShaker Fries are to be shaken in a bag.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes Demon Sauce.
Demon Sauce is a creamy, bold purple mustard.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes Hunter Sauce.
Hunter Sauce is a sweet chili sauce.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal includes a medium soft drink.
Each McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal comes with a pack of two KPop Demon Hunters photocards.
Each McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal comes with a Derpy access card.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal was released in the USA on March 31, 2026.
The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal is available for a limited time.
A separate, limited-time Derpy McFlurry featuring vanilla soft serve with berry popping pearls is available.
A Saja Boys breakfast meal option is available
